about: The upstream flash-detection suite's video cases, re-expressed as the relative luminance of each frame: read from the expected logs it pins (data/ExpectedVideoLogFiles/<case>_RELATIVE.csv, columns AverageLuminance, FlashAreaLuminance, LuminanceTransitions and FlashLuminanceFailedFrame), in the vendored folder for commit fd3e09e4e6 under doneright/oracles/vendor/ on branch doneright of DeepBuildAI/deepbuild. Every frame of a case is wholly at `low` or wholly at `high` (a flash area of 100% or 0%); `high_frames` lists the 1-based frames at `high`, first and last of each run. `upstream` keeps what the log says: the most transitions it counts in a second, the first frame it marks a flash fail (result 3) and the first it marks an extended fail (result 2), a rule of the upstream suite's own beyond the three-flash limit.
